description: A stark, mathematically perfect cube of seamless pale-gray material. The walls, floor, and ceiling are utterly featureless, windows, or adornments. Yet the ceiling glows with a soft, even, warm light that fills every corner with gentle illumination. The air is fresh and pleasantly warm, carrying a faint scent of clean linen. The silence is absolute, so thick you can hear your own heartbeat.
